get test Tecan data

Source: R/testdata.R
get_test_Tecan_data.Rd

get test Tecan data

Usage

get_test_Tecan_data()

Value

list with with input data (manifest/template/result paths) and related reference data (qs2 file paths)

Examples

get_test_Tecan_data()
#> $m_file
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpW1W92u/temp_libpath287971bdee5e/gDRimport/extdata/data2/manifest_Tecan_96_well_plates.xlsx"
#> 
#> $r_files
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpW1W92u/temp_libpath287971bdee5e/gDRimport/extdata/data2/RawData_Tecan_96_well_plates.xlsx"
#> 
#> $t_files
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpW1W92u/temp_libpath287971bdee5e/gDRimport/extdata/data2/D300_trt_Tecan_96_well_plates.xlsx"
#> 
#> $ref_m_df
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpW1W92u/temp_libpath287971bdee5e/gDRimport/extdata/data2/ref_manifest_Tecan_96_well_plates.qs2"
#> 
#> $ref_r_df
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpW1W92u/temp_libpath287971bdee5e/gDRimport/extdata/data2/ref_RawData_Tecan_96_well_plates.qs2"
#> 
#> $ref_t_df
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpW1W92u/temp_libpath287971bdee5e/gDRimport/extdata/data2/ref_D300_trt_Tecan_96_well_plates.qs2"
#>
